questions: Have you noticed a tremor or shaking in your hands, especially when they are at rest?
Have your movements become slower than they used to be?
Have you noticed a decrease in your ability to smell things?
Do you act out your dreams while sleeping (such as punching, kicking, or shouting)?
Do you have stiffness or rigidity in your arms or legs?
Has your handwriting become smaller than it used to be?
Have you had any falls or balance problems recently?
Do you have any difficulty swallowing?
Is there any family history of Parkinson's disease or a similar movement disorder?

dx_raw:
DIAGNOSIS: Oromandibular dystonia (segmental cranial dystonia of adult onset), idiopathic/sporadic

Alternatives:
1. Tardive oromandibular dystonia (dopamine-receptor blocker exposure not yet excluded)
2. Spontaneous orofacial dyskinesia of the elderly
3. Early Huntington's disease (adult-onset, otherwise negative workup)
